title: Toddler Unleashes Impossible Chantless Magic Blast — Part 3

series.summary: Roxy takes Rudeus outside for a magic demonstration, where he stuns her by releasing an overwhelming chantless water blast, earning her genuine respect and mentorship.

series_summary: Roxy takes Rudeus outside for a magic demonstration, where he stuns her by releasing an overwhelming chantless water blast, earning her genuine respect and mentorship.

cuts.voiceover_text: Standing before the training grounds, Roxy recites an elaborate incantation to demonstrate proper technique, firing a concentrated water spell into a distant boulder.
cuts.raw_narration: Standing before the training grounds, Roxy recites an elaborate incantation to demonstrate proper technique, firing a concentrated water spell into a distant boulder.

cuts.voiceover_text: Rudeus steps forward, completely skips the verbal chant, and releases a monstrous water blast that violently erupts across the clearing.
cuts.raw_narration: Rudeus steps forward, completely skips the verbal chant, and releases a monstrous water blast that violently erupts across the clearing.

cuts.voiceover_text: Drenched and completely astonished by the impossible torrent, Roxy realizes this toddler possesses power that surpasses seasoned masters. Humbled by his genius, she bows deeply and officially takes him as her apprentice.
cuts.raw_narration: Drenched and completely astonished by the impossible torrent, Roxy realizes this toddler possesses power that surpasses seasoned masters. Humbled by his genius, she bows deeply and officially takes him as her apprentice.

cuts.voiceover_text: Remembering the painful regrets of his former life, Rudeus watches the sunset with profound gratitude, swearing never to waste this second chance.
